gutenberg_kg.viz3d

viz3d.py — 3-D Knowledge Tree Forest visualiser for GutenbergKG.

Each book is rendered as a tree:

  • Trunk → document node (brown cylinder, height ∝ log(chunk_count))
  • Branches → section nodes (forest-green spheres radiating from trunk apex)
  • Leaves → chunk nodes (light-green spheres clustered around each section)
  • Spores → entity / topic nodes (gold dots floating above the canopy)

Books are grouped by genre into groves, with genres arranged in a large Fibonacci annulus so the whole corpus forms a navigable 3-D forest.

Requires: pyvista, pyvistaqt, PyQt5, param, numpy (all available in the pycode_kg environment).

Author: Eric G. Suchanek, PhD

 134@dataclass
 135class BookMeta:
 136    """Lightweight metadata for one corpus book."""
 137
 138    title: str
 139    genre: str
 140    book_dir: Path
 141
 142    @property
 143    def slug(self) -> str:
 144        """URL-safe identifier, used as a namespace prefix."""
 145        s = self.title.lower().strip()
 146        s = re.sub(r"[^\w\s-]", "", s)
 147        return re.sub(r"[\s-]+", "_", s)[:60]
 148
 149    @property
 150    def db_path(self) -> Path:
 151        """Path to this book's DocKG SQLite graph file."""
 152        return self.book_dir / ".dockg" / "graph.sqlite"
 153
 154    @property
 155    def has_kg(self) -> bool:
 156        """Whether a non-trivial DocKG SQLite file exists for this book."""
 157        return self.db_path.exists() and self.db_path.stat().st_size > 100
 158
 159
 160def _load_book_graph(
 161    meta: BookMeta,
 162) -> tuple[list[LayoutNode], list[LayoutEdge]]:
 163    """
 164    Load nodes and edges from a book's DocKG SQLite, prefixing all IDs with
 165    the book slug to prevent collisions when merging multiple books.
 166
 167    :param meta: Book metadata including slug and db_path.
 168    :return: ``(nodes, edges)`` with namespaced IDs.
 169    """
 170    prefix = f"{meta.slug}:"
 171    nodes: list[LayoutNode] = []
 172    edges: list[LayoutEdge] = []
 173
 174    with sqlite3.connect(meta.db_path) as con:
 175        for row in con.execute("SELECT id, kind, name, title, file_path, text FROM nodes"):
 176            nid, kind, name, title, file_path, text = row
 177            display_name = title or name or nid
 178            docstring = text[:500] if text else None
 179            nodes.append(
 180                LayoutNode(
 181                    id=prefix + nid,
 182                    kind=kind,
 183                    name=display_name,
 184                    module_path=file_path,
 185                    docstring=docstring,
 186                )
 187            )
 188        for row in con.execute("SELECT src, rel, dst FROM edges"):
 189            src, rel, dst = row
 190            edges.append(LayoutEdge(src=prefix + src, rel=rel, dst=prefix + dst))
 191
 192    return nodes, edges
 193

 200def scan_corpus(corpus_root: Path) -> dict[str, list[BookMeta]]:
 201    """
 202    Walk ``corpus_root`` and return ``{genre: [BookMeta, ...]}`` for every
 203    book directory that contains a ``.dockg/graph.sqlite``.
 204
 205    :param corpus_root: Root of the corpus directory tree.
 206    :return: Dict mapping genre name to list of book metadata objects.
 207    """
 208    result: dict[str, list[BookMeta]] = defaultdict(list)
 209    for genre_dir in sorted(corpus_root.iterdir()):
 210        if not genre_dir.is_dir() or genre_dir.name.startswith("."):
 211            continue
 212        genre = genre_dir.name
 213        for book_dir in sorted(genre_dir.iterdir()):
 214            if not book_dir.is_dir() or book_dir.name.startswith("."):
 215                continue
 216            meta = BookMeta(
 217                title=book_dir.name,
 218                genre=genre,
 219                book_dir=book_dir,
 220            )
 221            if meta.has_kg:
 222                result[genre].append(meta)
 223    return dict(result)
 224

 234class ForestLayout(Layout3D):
 235    """
 236    3-D forest layout for a multi-book corpus.
 237
 238    Spatial structure
 239    -----------------
 240    - **Genres** are placed in a large Fibonacci annulus in the XY plane
 241      (each genre → a grove at a fixed XY centre).
 242    - **Books** within a genre are placed in a medium Fibonacci annulus around
 243      the genre centre.
 244    - **Per book (tree)**:
 245        - ``document`` node sits at the book's XY position, ``Z = 0``
 246          (trunk base marker).
 247        - ``section`` nodes are distributed on a Fibonacci upper hemisphere
 248          centred at the trunk apex ``(bx, by, trunk_height)``.
 249          Trunk height scales as ``log2(1 + n_chunks)``.
 250        - ``chunk`` nodes cluster around their parent section node in a small
 251          Fibonacci sphere.
 252        - ``entity``/``topic`` nodes float in a loose cloud above the canopy
 253          at ``Z = trunk_height + canopy_lift``.
 254
 255    :param grove_inner_radius: Inner radius for genre placement ring.
 256    :param grove_outer_radius: Minimum outer radius for genre ring.
 257    :param book_inner_radius: Inner radius for books within a genre grove.
 258    :param book_outer_radius: Minimum outer radius within a genre grove.
 259    :param trunk_scale: Multiplier for trunk height (``trunk_height = trunk_scale * log2(1 + n_chunks)``).
 260    :param branch_radius: Base radius of the Fibonacci hemisphere for sections.
 261    :param leaf_radius: Base radius of the leaf sphere per section.
 262    :param canopy_lift: Z offset above trunk apex for entity / topic nodes.
 263    """
 264
 265    def __init__(
 266        self,
 267        grove_inner_radius: float = 80.0,
 268        grove_outer_radius: float = 240.0,
 269        book_inner_radius: float = 5.0,
 270        book_outer_radius: float = 18.0,
 271        trunk_scale: float = 4.0,
 272        max_trunk_height: float = 45.0,
 273        branch_radius: float = 5.0,
 274        leaf_radius: float = 1.5,
 275        canopy_lift: float = 4.0,
 276    ) -> None:
 277        """Store layout radii/scale parameters; see class docstring for their roles."""
 278        self.grove_inner_radius = grove_inner_radius
 279        self.grove_outer_radius = grove_outer_radius
 280        self.book_inner_radius = book_inner_radius
 281        self.book_outer_radius = book_outer_radius
 282        self.trunk_scale = trunk_scale
 283        self.max_trunk_height = max_trunk_height
 284        self.branch_radius = branch_radius
 285        self.leaf_radius = leaf_radius
 286        self.canopy_lift = canopy_lift
 287
 288        # Set during compute() so render helpers can read them
 289        self.trunk_positions: dict[str, np.ndarray] = {}  # doc_node_id → XYZ base
 290        self.trunk_heights: dict[str, float] = {}  # doc_node_id → height
 291        self.trunk_genres: dict[str, str] = {}  # doc_node_id → genre
 292        self.genre_color_map: dict[str, str] = {}  # genre → hex color
 293        # (trunk_axis_pt, section_tip_pt) for every section — drawn as branch lines
 294        self.branch_lines: list[tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]] = []
 295
 296    def compute(
 297        self,
 298        nodes: list[LayoutNode],
 299        edges: list[LayoutEdge],
 300    ) -> dict[str, np.ndarray]:
 301        """
 302        Compute 3-D positions for every node in the combined forest.
 303
 304        :param nodes: All nodes across all loaded books (IDs already namespaced).
 305        :param edges: All edges across all loaded books.
 306        :return: Mapping from node ID to ``[x, y, z]`` position.
 307        """
 308        # Reset per-compute state
 309        self.branch_lines = []
 310
 311        # Build containment hierarchy
 312        children: dict[str, list[str]] = defaultdict(list)
 313        for e in edges:
 314            if e.rel == "CONTAINS":
 315                children[e.src].append(e.dst)
 316
 317        node_by_id = {n.id: n for n in nodes}
 318        positions: dict[str, np.ndarray] = {}
 319
 320        # Group nodes by book slug (= first token before first ":")
 321        books_nodes: dict[str, list[LayoutNode]] = defaultdict(list)
 322        for n in nodes:
 323            slug = n.id.split(":")[0]
 324            books_nodes[slug].append(n)
 325
 326        # Group books by genre (slug → genre extracted from module_path / id)
 327        # We infer genre from document nodes: their module_path is the filename;
 328        # the genre was embedded by the caller into a special metadata node.
 329        # Simpler: group by traversal order — caller sets book_genre_map.
 330        # Use self._book_genre_map if set, else treat all books as one genre.
 331        book_genre_map: dict[str, str] = getattr(self, "_book_genre_map", {})
 332
 333        genres_books: dict[str, list[str]] = defaultdict(list)
 334        for slug in books_nodes:
 335            genre = book_genre_map.get(slug, "unknown")
 336            genres_books[genre].append(slug)
 337
 338        # Place genres in a large Fibonacci annulus
 339        genre_list = sorted(genres_books.keys())
 340        n_genres = max(len(genre_list), 1)
 341        genre_outer = max(self.grove_outer_radius, self.grove_inner_radius + n_genres * 12.0)
 342        grove_centers = fibonacci_annulus(
 343            n_genres,
 344            inner_radius=self.grove_inner_radius,
 345            outer_radius=genre_outer,
 346            center=np.zeros(3),
 347            z_thickness=0.0,
 348        )
 349        genre_center_map: dict[str, np.ndarray] = {
 350            g: np.array(p) for g, p in zip(genre_list, grove_centers)
 351        }
 352        self.genre_color_map = {
 353            g: GENRE_PALETTE[i % len(GENRE_PALETTE)] for i, g in enumerate(genre_list)
 354        }
 355
 356        # For each genre, place books in a medium annulus around the grove centre
 357        for genre, grove_center in genre_center_map.items():
 358            slugs = genres_books[genre]
 359            n_books = max(len(slugs), 1)
 360            book_outer = max(self.book_outer_radius, self.book_inner_radius + n_books * 3.0)
 361            book_positions = fibonacci_annulus(
 362                n_books,
 363                inner_radius=self.book_inner_radius,
 364                outer_radius=book_outer,
 365                center=grove_center,
 366                z_thickness=0.0,
 367            )
 368
 369            for slug, book_xy in zip(slugs, book_positions):
 370                bx, by = float(book_xy[0]), float(book_xy[1])
 371                book_nodes = books_nodes[slug]
 372
 373                # Count chunks to determine trunk height; cap so no book dominates
 374                n_chunks = sum(1 for n in book_nodes if n.kind == "chunk")
 375                trunk_height = min(
 376                    self.trunk_scale * max(1.0, np.log2(1 + n_chunks)),
 377                    self.max_trunk_height,
 378                )
 379                trunk_apex = np.array([bx, by, trunk_height])
 380
 381                # Find document nodes (trunk base)
 382                doc_nodes = [n for n in book_nodes if n.kind == "document"]
 383                for doc in doc_nodes:
 384                    positions[doc.id] = np.array([bx, by, 0.0])
 385                    self.trunk_positions[doc.id] = np.array([bx, by, 0.0])
 386                    self.trunk_heights[doc.id] = trunk_height
 387                    self.trunk_genres[doc.id] = genre
 388
 389                # Section nodes — spiral up the trunk (B: real tree branching)
 390                section_nodes = [n for n in book_nodes if n.kind == "section"]
 391                n_sections = len(section_nodes)
 392                golden_angle = np.pi * (3.0 - np.sqrt(5.0))  # ≈ 137.5°
 393                branch_length = 0.0  # reused by canopy cloud below
 394                if n_sections:
 395                    branch_length = self.branch_radius + np.sqrt(n_sections) * 0.5
 396                    for i, sec in enumerate(section_nodes):
 397                        t = i / max(n_sections - 1, 1)
 398                        z = trunk_height * (0.30 + 0.65 * t)
 399                        angle = i * golden_angle
 400                        radius = branch_length * (1.0 - (z / trunk_height) * 0.4)
 401                        sec_pos = np.array(
 402                            [
 403                                bx + radius * np.cos(angle),
 404                                by + radius * np.sin(angle),
 405                                z,
 406                            ]
 407                        )
 408                        positions[sec.id] = sec_pos
 409                        # Branch line: point on trunk axis at section's Z → section tip
 410                        self.branch_lines.append((np.array([bx, by, z]), sec_pos))
 411
 412                # Chunk nodes — upper-hemisphere cone above each branch tip
 413                sec_chunks: dict[str, list[str]] = {
 414                    n.id: children.get(n.id, []) for n in section_nodes
 415                }
 416                for sec in section_nodes:
 417                    _pos = positions.get(sec.id)
 418                    if _pos is None:
 419                        continue
 420                    sec_pos = _pos
 421                    chunk_ids = [
 422                        cid
 423                        for cid in sec_chunks.get(sec.id, [])
 424                        if node_by_id.get(cid) and node_by_id[cid].kind == "chunk"
 425                    ]
 426                    n_c = len(chunk_ids)
 427                    if not n_c:
 428                        continue
 429                    leaf_r = self.leaf_radius + np.sqrt(n_c) * 0.12
 430                    raw_pts = fibonacci_sphere(n_c * 3, radius=leaf_r, center=sec_pos)
 431                    upper_pts = [p for p in raw_pts if p[2] >= float(sec_pos[2])]
 432                    if len(upper_pts) < n_c:
 433                        # Reflect insufficient points above branch Z
 434                        upper_pts = [
 435                            np.array(
 436                                [p[0], p[1], float(sec_pos[2]) + abs(p[2] - float(sec_pos[2]))]
 437                            )
 438                            for p in raw_pts[:n_c]
 439                        ]
 440                    for cid, cpos in zip(chunk_ids, upper_pts[:n_c]):
 441                        positions[cid] = np.array(cpos)
 442
 443                # Chunks without a section parent (connected directly to document)
 444                doc_chunk_ids: list[str] = []
 445                for doc in doc_nodes:
 446                    doc_chunk_ids.extend(
 447                        cid
 448                        for cid in children.get(doc.id, [])
 449                        if node_by_id.get(cid)
 450                        and node_by_id[cid].kind == "chunk"
 451                        and cid not in positions
 452                    )
 453                if doc_chunk_ids:
 454                    raw_pts = fibonacci_sphere(
 455                        len(doc_chunk_ids) * 2, radius=self.leaf_radius, center=trunk_apex
 456                    )
 457                    upper_pts = [p for p in raw_pts if p[2] >= float(trunk_apex[2])]
 458                    if len(upper_pts) < len(doc_chunk_ids):
 459                        upper_pts = raw_pts[: len(doc_chunk_ids)]
 460                    for cid, cpos in zip(doc_chunk_ids, upper_pts[: len(doc_chunk_ids)]):
 461                        positions[cid] = np.array(cpos)
 462
 463                # Entity / topic / keyword → loose cloud above canopy
 464                canopy_z = trunk_height + self.canopy_lift
 465                canopy_center = np.array([bx, by, canopy_z])
 466                floaters = [
 467                    n
 468                    for n in book_nodes
 469                    if n.kind in ("entity", "topic", "keyword") and n.id not in positions
 470                ]
 471                if floaters:
 472                    cloud_r = branch_length * 1.1 if n_sections else self.branch_radius
 473                    cloud_pts = fibonacci_sphere(
 474                        len(floaters), radius=cloud_r, center=canopy_center
 475                    )
 476                    for n, pos in zip(floaters, cloud_pts):
 477                        positions[n.id] = np.array(pos)
 478
 479        # Orphans (anything still unplaced)
 480        orphans = [n for n in nodes if n.id not in positions]
 481        if orphans:
 482            orphan_pts = fibonacci_sphere(len(orphans), radius=5.0, center=np.zeros(3))
 483            for n, pos in zip(orphans, orphan_pts):
 484                positions[n.id] = np.array(pos)
 485
 486        return positions
 487

 489# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 490# Geometry helpers
 491# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 492
 493
 494def _arc_points(p1: np.ndarray, p2: np.ndarray, n_pts: int = 24, lift: float = 0.35) -> np.ndarray:
 495    """
 496    Quadratic Bézier arc from *p1* to *p2*, apex lifted in Z.
 497
 498    :param p1: Start point.
 499    :param p2: End point.
 500    :param n_pts: Sample count.
 501    :param lift: Z lift as fraction of chord length.
 502    :return: ``(n_pts, 3)`` array.
 503    """
 504    p1, p2 = np.asarray(p1, float), np.asarray(p2, float)
 505    mid = (p1 + p2) / 2.0
 506    mid[2] += lift * np.linalg.norm(p2 - p1)
 507    t = np.linspace(0.0, 1.0, n_pts)[:, None]
 508    return (1 - t) ** 2 * p1 + 2 * t * (1 - t) * mid + t**2 * p2
 509
 510
 511def _make_node_mesh(kind: str, center: np.ndarray, size: float, lod: str) -> pv.DataSet:
 512    """
 513    Return a PyVista mesh for a single node, shape-coded by kind.
 514
 515    All tiers use icosahedra — fast to build, good shading, no sphere overhead.
 516    LOD only varies the radius scale:
 517    - high  → full size
 518    - low   → 80 % size (octahedron for chunks to save faces)
 519    - points → tetrahedron (4 faces, minimal cost)
 520
 521    :param kind: Node kind string.
 522    :param center: 3-D centre position.
 523    :param size: Node radius.
 524    :param lod: LOD tier — ``"high"``, ``"low"``, or ``"points"``.
 525    :return: PyVista PolyData mesh.
 526    """
 527    if lod == "points":
 528        return pv.Tetrahedron(radius=size * 0.5, center=center)
 529    if lod == "low":
 530        if kind in ("chunk", "entity", "keyword", "topic"):
 531            return pv.Octahedron(radius=size * 0.8, center=center)
 532        return pv.Icosahedron(radius=size * 0.8, center=center)
 533    # high — full icosahedra for everything
 534    return pv.Icosahedron(radius=size, center=center)
 535
 536
 537def _glyph_proto(kind: str, size: float, lod: str) -> pv.PolyData:
 538    """Return a glyph prototype mesh centred at the origin for *kind* nodes.
 539
 540    Used with ``pv.PolyData.glyph()`` so all nodes of one kind are rendered
 541    in a single VTK draw call instead of one mesh per node.
 542
 543    :param kind: Node kind string.
 544    :param size: Node radius.
 545    :param lod: LOD tier — ``"high"``, ``"low"``, or ``"points"``.
 546    :return: PyVista PolyData centred at origin.
 547    """
 548    if lod == "points":
 549        return pv.Tetrahedron(radius=size * 0.5)
 550    if lod == "low":
 551        if kind in ("chunk", "entity", "keyword", "topic"):
 552            return pv.Octahedron(radius=size * 0.8)
 553        return pv.Icosahedron(radius=size * 0.8)
 554    return pv.Icosahedron(radius=size)
 555
 556
 557def _text_to_markdown(text: str | None) -> str:
 558    """Format a raw text excerpt as Markdown for the popup.
 559
 560    :param text: Raw node text (chunk content, entity name, etc.).
 561    :return: Markdown string.
 562    """
 563    if not text:
 564        return "No text available."
 565    return text.strip()
 566

 569# DocstringPopup — reused from pycode_kg pattern

 571
 572
 573class TextPopup(QDialog):
 574    """
 575    Modeless popup that renders node text as Markdown HTML.
 576
 577    :param title: Window title.
 578    :param text: Raw text content.
 579    :param parent: Parent widget.
 580    :param on_close_callback: Called when the window closes.
 581    """
 582
 583    def __init__(self, title: str, text: str, parent=None, on_close_callback=None):
 584        """Build the popup dialog: title bar, rendered Markdown browser, and Close button."""
 585        super().__init__(parent)
 586        self.setWindowTitle(title)
 587        self.setMinimumSize(640, 420)
 588        self.on_close_callback = on_close_callback
 589        self.setWindowModality(Qt.NonModal)  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
 590
 591        if parent:
 592            geo = parent.screen().geometry()
 593            self.move(geo.x() + 60, geo.y() + 60)
 594
 595        layout = QVBoxLayout(self)
 596        html = markdown(text or "No text available.")
 597        browser = QTextBrowser(self)
 598        browser.setHtml(html)
 599        layout.addWidget(browser)
 600
 601        close_btn = QPushButton("Close", self)
 602        close_btn.clicked.connect(self.close)  # type: ignore[arg-type]
 603        layout.addWidget(close_btn)
 604
 605    def closeEvent(self, event):
 606        """Invoke the close callback, if any, then let the dialog close normally."""
 607        if self.on_close_callback:
 608            self.on_close_callback()
 609        super().closeEvent(event)

 612# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 613# create_forest_visualization
 614# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 615
 616
 617def create_forest_visualization(
 618    viz: GutenbergForestVisualizer,
 619    nodes: list[LayoutNode],
 620    edges: list[LayoutEdge],
 621    plotter: pv.Plotter,
 622) -> tuple[pv.Plotter, str, dict[str, dict]]:
 623    """
 624    Render the knowledge tree forest into *plotter*.
 625
 626    Draws:
 627    - Forest floor (ground plane)
 628    - Per-book trunk cylinders (visual, not node meshes)
 629    - Node meshes grouped by kind (LOD-aware)
 630    - Structural edges (CONTAINS gray lines; SIMILAR_TO arcs)
 631
 632    :param viz: :class:`GutenbergForestVisualizer` instance.
 633    :param nodes: Filtered node list to render.
 634    :param edges: Full edge list (used for layout and edge rendering).
 635    :param plotter: The ``QtInteractor`` to render into.
 636    :return: ``(plotter, title_text, actor_to_node)``
 637    """
 638    viz.status = "Building forest scene..."
 639    QApplication.processEvents()
 640
 641    plotter.clear_actors()
 642    plotter.enable_anti_aliasing("msaa")
 643    plotter.set_background("#1a1a2e", top="#16213e")  # type: ignore[arg-type]  # night forest sky
 644
 645    # Ground plane — sized for 2× grove spacing
 646    ground = pv.Plane(center=(0, 0, -0.2), direction=(0, 0, 1), i_size=1000, j_size=1000)
 647    plotter.add_mesh(ground, color="#2d4a1e", opacity=1.0, name="ground")
 648
 649    # -- Compute layout
 650    layout = ForestLayout()
 651    layout._book_genre_map = viz._book_genre_map  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
 652    all_positions = layout.compute(viz.all_nodes, viz.all_edges)
 653
 654    # -- Draw trunk cylinders — single merged mesh with genre_idx scalar (A)
 655    # One add_mesh call regardless of genre count keeps actor/texture count low.
 656    viz.status = "Drawing trunks..."
 657    QApplication.processEvents()
 658    _trunk_meshes: list[pv.PolyData] = []
 659    _genre_list_ord = sorted(layout.genre_color_map.keys())
 660    _genre_to_idx: dict[str, float] = {g: float(i) for i, g in enumerate(_genre_list_ord)}
 661    for doc_id, base in layout.trunk_positions.items():
 662        height = layout.trunk_heights.get(doc_id, 8.0)
 663        genre = layout.trunk_genres.get(doc_id, "unknown")
 664        cyl = pv.Cylinder(
 665            center=(base[0], base[1], height / 2),
 666            direction=(0, 0, 1),
 667            radius=0.4,
 668            height=height,
 669            resolution=12,
 670        )
 671        cyl.cell_data["genre_idx"] = np.full(cyl.n_cells, _genre_to_idx.get(genre, 0.0))
 672        _trunk_meshes.append(cyl)
 673    if _trunk_meshes:
 674        from matplotlib.colors import ListedColormap  # pyvista dependency, always present
 675
 676        _combined_trunks = pv.merge(_trunk_meshes)
 677        _genre_colors = [layout.genre_color_map.get(g, TRUNK_COLOR) for g in _genre_list_ord]
 678        _trunk_cmap = ListedColormap(_genre_colors)
 679        _n_genres = max(1, len(_genre_list_ord))
 680        plotter.add_mesh(
 681            _combined_trunks,
 682            scalars="genre_idx",
 683            cmap=_trunk_cmap,
 684            clim=[-0.5, _n_genres - 0.5],
 685            show_scalar_bar=False,
 686            name="trunks",
 687        )
 688
 689    # -- Branch lines: trunk-axis point → section tip (flat numpy, zero per-line objects)
 690    if layout.branch_lines:
 691        _n_bl = len(layout.branch_lines)
 692        _bl_pts = np.empty((_n_bl * 2, 3), dtype=float)
 693        _bl_pts[0::2] = [bl[0] for bl in layout.branch_lines]
 694        _bl_pts[1::2] = [bl[1] for bl in layout.branch_lines]
 695        _bl_cells = np.empty(_n_bl * 3, dtype=np.intp)
 696        _bl_cells[0::3] = 2
 697        _bl_cells[1::3] = np.arange(0, _n_bl * 2, 2)
 698        _bl_cells[2::3] = np.arange(1, _n_bl * 2 + 1, 2)
 699        _branch_mesh = pv.PolyData()
 700        _branch_mesh.points = _bl_pts
 701        _branch_mesh.lines = _bl_cells
 702        plotter.add_mesh(
 703            _branch_mesh, color=BRANCH_COLOR, line_width=2.0, opacity=0.85, name="branches"
 704        )
 705
 706    # -- LOD tier
 707    n_visible = len(nodes)
 708    lod = "high" if n_visible <= LOD_HIGH else "low" if n_visible <= LOD_LOW else "points"
 709
 710    # -- Glyph rendering: O(kinds) Python work, not O(nodes)
 711    # Bucket positions and metadata by kind in one pass, then glyph each kind.
 712    kind_pts: dict[str, list[np.ndarray]] = {k: [] for k in KIND_SIZE}
 713    kind_meta: dict[str, list] = {k: [] for k in KIND_SIZE}
 714    node_id_set: set[str] = set()
 715
 716    for node in nodes:
 717        pos = all_positions.get(node.id)
 718        if pos is None:
 719            continue
 720        kind = node.kind if node.kind in KIND_SIZE else "chunk"
 721        kind_pts[kind].append(pos)
 722        kind_meta[kind].append(node)
 723        node_id_set.add(node.id)
 724
 725    actor_to_node: dict[str, dict] = {}
 726    viz.status = "Rendering nodes..."
 727    QApplication.processEvents()
 728
 729    for kind in KIND_SIZE:
 730        pts = kind_pts[kind]
 731        if not pts:
 732            continue
 733        arr = np.array(pts, dtype=float)
 734        cloud = pv.PolyData(arr)
 735        proto = _glyph_proto(kind, KIND_SIZE[kind], lod)
 736        glyphed = cloud.glyph(geom=proto, orient=False, scale=False)
 737        plotter.add_mesh(glyphed, color=KIND_COLOR[kind], show_edges=False, name=f"{kind}_nodes")
 738        for i, (node, pos) in enumerate(zip(kind_meta[kind], pts)):
 739            actor_to_node[f"{kind}_{i}"] = {
 740                "kind": kind,
 741                "id": node.id,
 742                "name": node.name,
 743                "docstring": node.docstring,
 744                "position": np.asarray(pos, float),
 745            }
 746
 747    # -- Edge rendering (CONTAINS structural lines + optional SIMILAR_TO arcs)
 748    viz.status = "Rendering edges..."
 749    QApplication.processEvents()
 750
 751    rel_to_show: set[str] = set()
 752    if viz.show_contains:
 753        rel_to_show.add("CONTAINS")
 754    if viz.show_similar:
 755        rel_to_show.add("SIMILAR_TO")
 756    if viz.show_next:
 757        rel_to_show.add("NEXT")
 758
 759    rel_blocks: dict[str, pv.MultiBlock] = {r: pv.MultiBlock() for r in rel_to_show}
 760    edge_counts: dict[str, int] = {r: 0 for r in rel_to_show}
 761    MAX_EDGES = 4000
 762
 763    for edge in edges:
 764        if edge.rel not in rel_to_show:
 765            continue
 766        if edge.src not in node_id_set or edge.dst not in node_id_set:
 767            continue
 768        if edge_counts[edge.rel] >= MAX_EDGES:
 769            continue
 770        p1, p2 = all_positions.get(edge.src), all_positions.get(edge.dst)
 771        if p1 is None or p2 is None:
 772            continue
 773        if edge.rel == "CONTAINS":
 774            rel_blocks["CONTAINS"].append(pv.Line(p1, p2))
 775        else:
 776            arc_pts = _arc_points(p1, p2)
 777            rel_blocks[edge.rel].append(pv.Spline(arc_pts, n_points=24))
 778        edge_counts[edge.rel] += 1
 779
 780    for rel, block in rel_blocks.items():
 781        if block.n_blocks > 0:
 782            is_contains = rel == "CONTAINS"
 783            plotter.add_mesh(
 784                block,
 785                color=REL_COLOR[rel],
 786                line_width=3.0 if is_contains else 2.0,
 787                opacity=0.45 if is_contains else 0.8,
 788                name=f"{rel.lower()}_edges",
 789            )
 790
 791    # -- Stats
 792    counts = Counter(n.kind for n in nodes)
 793    title = (
 794        f"Gutenberg KG Forest | {len({n.id.split(':')[0] for n in viz.all_nodes})} books | "
 795        f"docs={counts.get('document', 0)}  "
 796        f"sections={counts.get('section', 0)}  "
 797        f"chunks={counts.get('chunk', 0)}  "
 798        f"entities={counts.get('entity', 0)}"
 799    )
 800
 801    plotter.reset_camera()  # type: ignore[call-arg]
 802    plotter.view_isometric()  # type: ignore[call-arg]
 803    plotter.render()
 804    plotter.camera.zoom(2)
 805
 806    viz.status = "Forest rendered."
 807    QApplication.processEvents()
 808    return plotter, title, actor_to_node
 809
 810
 811# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 812# GutenbergForestVisualizer — data and state model
 813# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 814
 815
 816class GutenbergForestVisualizer(param.Parameterized):
 817    """
 818    Data and state model for the Gutenberg 3-D forest visualiser.
 819
 820    Reactive attributes (via ``param``) drive the Qt control panel.
 821
 822    :param corpus_root: Path to the corpus directory.
 823    :param plotter: The ``QtInteractor`` to render into.
 824    """
 825
 826    corpus_root: str = param.String(default=DEFAULT_CORPUS, doc="Corpus root path")
 827    save_path: str = param.String(default=DEFAULT_SAVE, doc="Save path stem")
 828    save_format: str = param.Selector(
 829        objects=["html", "png", "jpg"], default="html", doc="Export format"
 830    )
 831
 832    # Visibility toggles by node kind
 833    show_sections: bool = param.Boolean(default=True, doc="Render section (branch) nodes")
 834    show_chunks: bool = param.Boolean(default=True, doc="Render chunk (leaf) nodes")
 835    show_entities: bool = param.Boolean(default=False, doc="Render entity / topic nodes")
 836
 837    # Edge visibility
 838    show_contains: bool = param.Boolean(default=False, doc="CONTAINS structural edges")
 839    show_similar: bool = param.Boolean(default=False, doc="SIMILAR_TO semantic edges")
 840    show_next: bool = param.Boolean(default=False, doc="NEXT sequential edges")
 841
 842    # Status / title
 843    status: str = param.String(default="Ready", doc="Status bar text")
 844    window_title: str = param.String(
 845        default=f"Gutenberg KG Forest v{__version__}", doc="Window title"
 846    )
 847
 848    # Stats
 849    num_books: int = param.Integer(default=0)
 850    num_genres: int = param.Integer(default=0)
 851
 852    # Genre / book selectors
 853    available_genres: list[str] = param.List(default=[], doc="Available genre names")
 854    selected_genres: list[str] = param.ListSelector(default=[], objects=[], doc="Selected genres")
 855    available_books: list[str] = param.List(default=[], doc="Books in selected genres")
 856    selected_books: list[str] = param.ListSelector(
 857        default=[], objects=[], doc="Selected books (empty = all in genre)"
 858    )
 859
 860    def __init__(self, plotter: pv.Plotter | None = None, **params) -> None:
 861        """
 862        Initialise the visualiser data model.
 863
 864        :param plotter: The ``QtInteractor`` to render into.
 865        :param params: Additional ``param`` keyword arguments.
 866        """
 867        super().__init__(**params)
 868        self.plotter: pv.Plotter | None = plotter
 869
 870        # Book catalogue: {genre: [BookMeta]}
 871        self._catalogue: dict[str, list[BookMeta]] = {}
 872        # Loaded graph data (all books currently selected)
 873        self.all_nodes: list[LayoutNode] = []
 874        self.all_edges: list[LayoutEdge] = []
 875        # slug → genre mapping for ForestLayout
 876        self._book_genre_map: dict[str, str] = {}
 877
 878        self.actor_to_node: dict[str, dict] = {}
 879        self._load_catalogue()
 880
 881    @param.depends("corpus_root", watch=True)
 882    def _load_catalogue(self) -> None:
 883        """Scan corpus_root and populate the genre/book selectors."""
 884        root = Path(self.corpus_root)
 885        if not root.exists():
 886            self.status = f"Corpus not found: {root}"
 887            return
 888
 889        self.status = "Scanning corpus..."
 890        QApplication.processEvents()
 891
 892        self._catalogue = scan_corpus(root)
 893        genres = sorted(self._catalogue.keys())
 894        self.available_genres = genres
 895        self.param.selected_genres.objects = genres
 896        self.selected_genres = []
 897
 898        n_books = sum(len(v) for v in self._catalogue.values())
 899        self.num_genres = len(genres)
 900        self.num_books = n_books
 901        self.status = f"Corpus: {len(genres)} genres, {n_books} ingested books"
 902
 903    @param.depends("selected_genres", watch=True)
 904    def _on_genre_change(self) -> None:
 905        """Refresh available books when genre selection changes."""
 906        books: list[str] = []
 907        for genre in self.selected_genres:
 908            for meta in self._catalogue.get(genre, []):
 909                books.append(meta.title)
 910        books.sort()
 911        self.available_books = books
 912        self.param.selected_books.objects = books
 913        self.selected_books = []
 914
 915    def load_selected(self) -> None:
 916        """
 917        Load nodes and edges for the currently selected genres/books.
 918        Populates :attr:`all_nodes`, :attr:`all_edges`, :attr:`_book_genre_map`.
 919        """
 920        self.status = "Loading book graphs..."
 921        QApplication.processEvents()
 922
 923        genres_to_load = self.selected_genres or list(self._catalogue.keys())
 924        books_filter = set(self.selected_books)
 925
 926        self.all_nodes = []
 927        self.all_edges = []
 928        self._book_genre_map = {}
 929
 930        loaded = 0
 931        for genre in genres_to_load:
 932            for meta in self._catalogue.get(genre, []):
 933                if books_filter and meta.title not in books_filter:
 934                    continue
 935                self.status = f"Loading: {meta.title}"
 936                QApplication.processEvents()
 937                try:
 938                    nodes, edges = _load_book_graph(meta)
 939                    self.all_nodes.extend(nodes)
 940                    self.all_edges.extend(edges)
 941                    self._book_genre_map[meta.slug] = genre
 942                    loaded += 1
 943                except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
 944                    logger.warning("Failed to load %s: %s", meta.title, exc)
 945
 946        self.status = (
 947            f"Loaded {loaded} book(s): {len(self.all_nodes):,} nodes, {len(self.all_edges):,} edges"
 948        )
 949
 950    def _visible_nodes(self) -> list[LayoutNode]:
 951        """Apply kind visibility filters and return renderable node list."""
 952        visible_kinds: set[str] = {"document"}
 953        if self.show_sections:
 954            visible_kinds.add("section")
 955        if self.show_chunks:
 956            visible_kinds.add("chunk")
 957        if self.show_entities:
 958            visible_kinds.update(("entity", "topic", "keyword"))
 959        return [n for n in self.all_nodes if n.kind in visible_kinds]
 960
 961    def visualize(self) -> None:
 962        """Load selected books and render the 3-D forest."""
 963        if not self.plotter:
 964            return
 965        self.load_selected()
 966        if not self.all_nodes:
 967            self.status = "No books loaded — select a genre and render."
 968            return
 969
 970        visible = self._visible_nodes()
 971        try:
 972            _, title, actor_to_node = create_forest_visualization(
 973                self, visible, self.all_edges, self.plotter
 974            )
 975            self.actor_to_node = actor_to_node
 976            self.window_title = title
 977        except (ValueError, RuntimeError) as exc:
 978            self.status = f"Error: {exc}"
 979            logger.exception("Render error")
 980
 981
 982# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 983# ForestMainWindow
 984# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 985
 986
 987class ForestMainWindow(QMainWindow):
 988    """
 989    Qt main window for the Gutenberg 3-D forest visualiser.
 990
 991    Left panel  — corpus path, genre selector, book selector, render options.
 992    Right panel — PyVista QtInteractor + button row.
 993
 994    :param corpus_root: Path to the corpus directory.
 995    :param save_path: Default output file stem for exports.
 996    :param width: Initial window width in pixels.
 997    :param height: Initial window height in pixels.
 998    """
 999
1000    status_changed: pyqtSignal = pyqtSignal(str)
1001
1002    def __init__(
1003        self,
1004        corpus_root: str = DEFAULT_CORPUS,
1005        save_path: str = DEFAULT_SAVE,
1006        width: int = 1500,
1007        height: int = 950,
1008    ) -> None:
1009        """Build the main window: control/viewport panels, mesh picking, and signal wiring."""
1010        super().__init__()
1011        self.timer = None
1012        self._current_picked_actor = None
1013        self._current_popup: TextPopup | None = None
1014
1015        self.setGeometry(100, 100, width, height)
1016
1017        self.vtk_plotter: QtInteractor = QtInteractor(self)
1018        self.visualizer: GutenbergForestVisualizer = GutenbergForestVisualizer(
1019            plotter=self.vtk_plotter,
1020            corpus_root=corpus_root,
1021            save_path=save_path,
1022        )
1023        self.plotter = self.vtk_plotter
1024
1025        self.setWindowTitle(self.visualizer.window_title)
1026
1027        central = QWidget()
1028        self.setCentralWidget(central)
1029        main_layout = QHBoxLayout(central)
1030
1031        self.setStyleSheet("""
1032            QPushButton {
1033                background-color: #2E8B57; color: white;
1034                border: none; border-radius: 3px; padding: 6px; margin: 2px;
1035            }
1036            QPushButton#reset-view  { background-color: #FFEB3B; color: black; }
1037            QPushButton#reset-all   { background-color: #8B0000; color: white; }
1038            QPushButton { font-size: 12px; }
1039            QWidget { background-color: #1a1a2e; color: #e0e0e0; }
1040            QLabel  { background: transparent; border: none; }
1041        """)
1042
1043        ctrl_widget = self._build_control_panel()
1044        vis_widget = self._build_viewport_panel()
1045
1046        main_layout.addWidget(ctrl_widget)
1047        main_layout.addWidget(vis_widget, stretch=1)
1048        main_layout.setContentsMargins(0, 0, 0, 0)
1049        main_layout.setSpacing(4)
1050
1051        ctrl_widget.setSizePolicy(QSizePolicy.Preferred, QSizePolicy.MinimumExpanding)
1052
1053        self._setup_mesh_picking()
1054        self._connect_signals()
1055
1056        self.setFont(QFont("Arial", 12))
1057        self.resize(width, height)
1058
1059    # -- UI builder helpers --------------------------------------------------
1060
1061    @staticmethod
1062    def _h2(text: str) -> QLabel:
1063        """Build a bold, light-green section-heading label for the control panel."""
1064        lbl = QLabel(f"<b style='font-size:13px;color:#90EE90'>{text}</b>")
1065        lbl.setStyleSheet("background:transparent; border:none;")
1066        return lbl
1067
1068    @staticmethod
1069    def _lbl(text: str) -> QLabel:
1070        """Build a plain, muted-gray text label for the control panel."""
1071        lbl = QLabel(text)
1072        lbl.setStyleSheet("background:transparent; border:none; color:#c0c0c0;")
1073        return lbl
1074
1075    def _build_control_panel(self) -> QWidget:
1076        """Build the left control panel: corpus path, genre/book selectors, visibility
1077        checkboxes, stats label, and render/save buttons."""
1078        ctrl = QVBoxLayout()
1079        ctrl.setSpacing(10)
1080        ctrl.setContentsMargins(6, 6, 6, 6)
1081
1082        # Corpus path
1083        ctrl.addWidget(self._h2("Corpus"))
1084        self.corpus_input = QLineEdit(self.visualizer.corpus_root)
1085        self.corpus_input.setPlaceholderText("corpus/")
1086        ctrl.addWidget(self.corpus_input)
1087
1088        # Genre selector
1089        ctrl.addWidget(self._h2("Genres"))
1090        ctrl.addWidget(self._lbl("Select genres (empty = all):"))
1091        self.genre_selector = QListWidget()
1092        self.genre_selector.setSelectionMode(QListWidget.MultiSelection)
1093        self.genre_selector.setMaximumHeight(100)
1094        for g in self.visualizer.available_genres:
1095            self.genre_selector.addItem(g)
1096        ctrl.addWidget(self.genre_selector)
1097
1098        # Book selector
1099        ctrl.addWidget(self._h2("Books"))
1100        ctrl.addWidget(self._lbl("Select books (empty = all in genre):"))
1101        self.book_selector = QListWidget()
1102        self.book_selector.setSelectionMode(QListWidget.MultiSelection)

1288    def on_pick(self, actor) -> None:
1289        """Right-click callback: find nearest node and show text popup."""
1290        if not self.visualizer.plotter:
1291            return
1292        self._clear_highlight()
1293        if self._current_popup and self._current_popup.isVisible():
1294            self._current_popup.close()
1295            self._current_popup = None
1296        if actor is None:
1297            self.update_status_display("Right-click a node sphere or trunk to inspect.")
1298            return
1299        if not hasattr(self.vtk_plotter, "picked_point") or self.vtk_plotter.picked_point is None:
1300            self.update_status_display("No pick point — zoom in and right-click closer to a node.")
1301            return
1302
1303        picked_point = np.asarray(self.vtk_plotter.picked_point, float)
1304
1305        # Identify actor name and map to a node kind
1306        picked_kind: str | None = None
1307        for name, act in self.plotter.actors.items():
1308            if act != actor:
1309                continue
1310            if name == "trunks":
1311                # Trunk click → find nearest document node (shows book info)
1312                picked_kind = "document"
1313            else:
1314                for kind in KIND_SIZE:
1315                    if name == f"{kind}_nodes":
1316                        picked_kind = kind
1317                        break
1318            break
1319
1320        if picked_kind is None:
1321            self.update_status_display("Click on a node sphere or trunk cylinder.")
1322            return
1323
1324        # Find closest node of that kind
1325        best_id, best_dist = None, float("inf")
1326        for mesh_id, elem in self.visualizer.actor_to_node.items():
1327            if elem["kind"] != picked_kind:
1328                continue
1329            d = float(np.linalg.norm(np.asarray(elem["position"], float) - picked_point))
1330            if d < best_dist:
1331                best_dist = d
1332                best_id = mesh_id
1333
1334        if best_id is None:
1335            self.update_status_display(f"No {picked_kind} node near pick point.")
1336            return
1337
1338        elem = self.visualizer.actor_to_node[best_id]
1339        # Build highlight mesh at the picked node position (no per-node mesh stored)
1340        pos = np.asarray(elem["position"], float)
1341        highlight = _make_node_mesh(elem["kind"], pos, KIND_SIZE[elem["kind"]] * 1.5, "high")
1342        self._highlight_mesh(highlight)
1343
1344        kind_label = elem["kind"].capitalize()
1345        raw_name = elem["name"]
1346        title = f"{kind_label}: {raw_name}"
1347        text = elem.get("docstring") or f"**{raw_name}**\n\n_{kind_label} node._"
1348        self._current_popup = TextPopup(title, text, self, on_close_callback=self._on_popup_close)
1349        self._current_popup.show()
1350        self.update_status_display(f"Picked: {title} (dist {best_dist:.1f})")
1351
1352    def _highlight_mesh(self, mesh) -> None:
1353        """Clear any existing highlight, then add *mesh* as the yellow-edged highlight actor."""
1354        self._clear_highlight()
1355        self.plotter.add_mesh(
1356            mesh,
1357            color="white",
1358            show_edges=True,
1359            edge_color="yellow",
1360            line_width=3,
1361            pickable=False,
1362            show_scalar_bar=False,
1363            reset_camera=False,
1364            name="_forest_highlight",
1365        )
1366        self._current_picked_actor = self.plotter.actors.get("_forest_highlight")
1367
1368    def _clear_highlight(self) -> None:
1369        """Remove the current pick-highlight actor from the plotter, if one exists."""
1370        if self._current_picked_actor:
1371            try:
1372                self.plotter.remove_actor(self._current_picked_actor, reset_camera=False)
1373            except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
1374                pass
1375            self._current_picked_actor = None
1376
1377    def _on_popup_close(self) -> None:
1378        """TextPopup close callback: clear the pick highlight and re-render the scene."""
1379        self._clear_highlight()
1380        self.plotter.render()

1382    def show_selected_text(self) -> None:

1410    def save_current_view(self) -> None:

1412        save_path = Path(self.visualizer.save_path)
1413        fmt = self.visualizer.save_format
1414        if save_path.suffix.lstrip(".") != fmt:
1415            save_path = save_path.with_suffix(f".{fmt}")
1416        self.visualizer.status = f"Saving → {save_path}…"
1417        QApplication.processEvents()
1418        try:
1419            save_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
1420            if fmt == "html":
1421                self.plotter.export_html(str(save_path))
1422            else:
1423                self.plotter.screenshot(str(save_path))
1424            self.visualizer.status = f"Saved → {save_path}"
1425        except (OSError, RuntimeError, ImportError) as exc:
1426            self.visualizer.status = f"Error saving: {exc}"

1451    def update_status_display(self, status: str) -> None:

1453        if status.startswith("Error"):
1454            html = f"<span style='color:#FF6B6B;font-size:13px;'><b>{status}</b></span>"
1455        elif any(kw in status for kw in ("Rendering", "Loading", "Building", "Drawing")):
1456            html = f"<span style='color:#87CEEB;font-size:13px;'><b>⏳ {status}</b></span>"
1457        elif any(kw in status for kw in ("rendered", "Saved", "Loaded", "Corpus")):
1458            html = f"<span style='color:#90EE90;font-size:13px;'><b>✓ {status}</b></span>"
1459        else:
1460            html = f"<span style='color:#c0c0c0;font-size:13px;'>{status}</span>"
1461        self.status_display.setText(html)

1469    def cleanup(self) -> None:
1470        """Close any open popup and tear down the VTK plotter to release GPU resources."""
1471        if self._current_popup and hasattr(self._current_popup, "isVisible"):
1472            try:
1473                self._current_popup.close()
1474            except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
1475                pass
1476        if self.plotter:
1477            try:
1478                self.plotter.clear_actors()
1479                self.plotter.close()
1480                self.visualizer.plotter = None
1481                self.plotter = None
1482                self.vtk_plotter = None
1483            except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
1484                pass
1485        gc.collect()

1487    def closeEvent(self, event) -> None:
1488        """Qt window-close handler: run :meth:`cleanup` (warnings suppressed) then accept."""
1489        with warnings.catch_warnings():
1490            warnings.simplefilter("ignore")
1491            try:
1492                self.cleanup()
1493            except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
1494                pass
1495        event.accept()

1526    sys.exit(app.exec())

def scan_corpus( corpus_root: pathlib.Path) -> dict[str, list[BookMeta]]: 
201def scan_corpus(corpus_root: Path) -> dict[str, list[BookMeta]]:
202    """
203    Walk ``corpus_root`` and return ``{genre: [BookMeta, ...]}`` for every
204    book directory that contains a ``.dockg/graph.sqlite``.
205
206    :param corpus_root: Root of the corpus directory tree.
207    :return: Dict mapping genre name to list of book metadata objects.
208    """
209    result: dict[str, list[BookMeta]] = defaultdict(list)
210    for genre_dir in sorted(corpus_root.iterdir()):
211        if not genre_dir.is_dir() or genre_dir.name.startswith("."):
212            continue
213        genre = genre_dir.name
214        for book_dir in sorted(genre_dir.iterdir()):
215            if not book_dir.is_dir() or book_dir.name.startswith("."):
216                continue
217            meta = BookMeta(
218                title=book_dir.name,
219                genre=genre,
220                book_dir=book_dir,
221            )
222            if meta.has_kg:
223                result[genre].append(meta)
224    return dict(result)

class ForestLayout(pycode_kg.layout3d.Layout3D): 
235class ForestLayout(Layout3D):
236    """
237    3-D forest layout for a multi-book corpus.
238
239    Spatial structure
240    -----------------
241    - **Genres** are placed in a large Fibonacci annulus in the XY plane
242      (each genre → a grove at a fixed XY centre).
243    - **Books** within a genre are placed in a medium Fibonacci annulus around
244      the genre centre.
245    - **Per book (tree)**:
246        - ``document`` node sits at the book's XY position, ``Z = 0``
247          (trunk base marker).
248        - ``section`` nodes are distributed on a Fibonacci upper hemisphere
249          centred at the trunk apex ``(bx, by, trunk_height)``.
250          Trunk height scales as ``log2(1 + n_chunks)``.
251        - ``chunk`` nodes cluster around their parent section node in a small
252          Fibonacci sphere.
253        - ``entity``/``topic`` nodes float in a loose cloud above the canopy
254          at ``Z = trunk_height + canopy_lift``.
255
256    :param grove_inner_radius: Inner radius for genre placement ring.
257    :param grove_outer_radius: Minimum outer radius for genre ring.
258    :param book_inner_radius: Inner radius for books within a genre grove.
259    :param book_outer_radius: Minimum outer radius within a genre grove.
260    :param trunk_scale: Multiplier for trunk height (``trunk_height = trunk_scale * log2(1 + n_chunks)``).
261    :param branch_radius: Base radius of the Fibonacci hemisphere for sections.
262    :param leaf_radius: Base radius of the leaf sphere per section.
263    :param canopy_lift: Z offset above trunk apex for entity / topic nodes.
264    """
265
266    def __init__(
267        self,
268        grove_inner_radius: float = 80.0,
269        grove_outer_radius: float = 240.0,
270        book_inner_radius: float = 5.0,
271        book_outer_radius: float = 18.0,
272        trunk_scale: float = 4.0,
273        max_trunk_height: float = 45.0,
274        branch_radius: float = 5.0,
275        leaf_radius: float = 1.5,
276        canopy_lift: float = 4.0,
277    ) -> None:
278        """Store layout radii/scale parameters; see class docstring for their roles."""
279        self.grove_inner_radius = grove_inner_radius
280        self.grove_outer_radius = grove_outer_radius
281        self.book_inner_radius = book_inner_radius
282        self.book_outer_radius = book_outer_radius
283        self.trunk_scale = trunk_scale
284        self.max_trunk_height = max_trunk_height
285        self.branch_radius = branch_radius
286        self.leaf_radius = leaf_radius
287        self.canopy_lift = canopy_lift
288
289        # Set during compute() so render helpers can read them
290        self.trunk_positions: dict[str, np.ndarray] = {}  # doc_node_id → XYZ base
291        self.trunk_heights: dict[str, float] = {}  # doc_node_id → height
292        self.trunk_genres: dict[str, str] = {}  # doc_node_id → genre
293        self.genre_color_map: dict[str, str] = {}  # genre → hex color
294        # (trunk_axis_pt, section_tip_pt) for every section — drawn as branch lines
295        self.branch_lines: list[tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]] = []
296
297    def compute(
298        self,
299        nodes: list[LayoutNode],
300        edges: list[LayoutEdge],
301    ) -> dict[str, np.ndarray]:
302        """
303        Compute 3-D positions for every node in the combined forest.
304
305        :param nodes: All nodes across all loaded books (IDs already namespaced).
306        :param edges: All edges across all loaded books.
307        :return: Mapping from node ID to ``[x, y, z]`` position.
308        """
309        # Reset per-compute state
310        self.branch_lines = []
311
312        # Build containment hierarchy
313        children: dict[str, list[str]] = defaultdict(list)
314        for e in edges:
315            if e.rel == "CONTAINS":
316                children[e.src].append(e.dst)
317
318        node_by_id = {n.id: n for n in nodes}
319        positions: dict[str, np.ndarray] = {}
320
321        # Group nodes by book slug (= first token before first ":")
322        books_nodes: dict[str, list[LayoutNode]] = defaultdict(list)
323        for n in nodes:
324            slug = n.id.split(":")[0]
325            books_nodes[slug].append(n)
326
327        # Group books by genre (slug → genre extracted from module_path / id)
328        # We infer genre from document nodes: their module_path is the filename;
329        # the genre was embedded by the caller into a special metadata node.
330        # Simpler: group by traversal order — caller sets book_genre_map.
331        # Use self._book_genre_map if set, else treat all books as one genre.
332        book_genre_map: dict[str, str] = getattr(self, "_book_genre_map", {})
333
334        genres_books: dict[str, list[str]] = defaultdict(list)
335        for slug in books_nodes:
336            genre = book_genre_map.get(slug, "unknown")
337            genres_books[genre].append(slug)
338
339        # Place genres in a large Fibonacci annulus
340        genre_list = sorted(genres_books.keys())
341        n_genres = max(len(genre_list), 1)
342        genre_outer = max(self.grove_outer_radius, self.grove_inner_radius + n_genres * 12.0)
343        grove_centers = fibonacci_annulus(
344            n_genres,
345            inner_radius=self.grove_inner_radius,
346            outer_radius=genre_outer,
347            center=np.zeros(3),
348            z_thickness=0.0,
349        )
350        genre_center_map: dict[str, np.ndarray] = {
351            g: np.array(p) for g, p in zip(genre_list, grove_centers)
352        }
353        self.genre_color_map = {
354            g: GENRE_PALETTE[i % len(GENRE_PALETTE)] for i, g in enumerate(genre_list)
355        }
356
357        # For each genre, place books in a medium annulus around the grove centre
358        for genre, grove_center in genre_center_map.items():
359            slugs = genres_books[genre]
360            n_books = max(len(slugs), 1)
361            book_outer = max(self.book_outer_radius, self.book_inner_radius + n_books * 3.0)
362            book_positions = fibonacci_annulus(
363                n_books,
364                inner_radius=self.book_inner_radius,
365                outer_radius=book_outer,
366                center=grove_center,
367                z_thickness=0.0,
368            )
369
370            for slug, book_xy in zip(slugs, book_positions):
371                bx, by = float(book_xy[0]), float(book_xy[1])
372                book_nodes = books_nodes[slug]
373
374                # Count chunks to determine trunk height; cap so no book dominates
375                n_chunks = sum(1 for n in book_nodes if n.kind == "chunk")
376                trunk_height = min(
377                    self.trunk_scale * max(1.0, np.log2(1 + n_chunks)),
378                    self.max_trunk_height,
379                )
380                trunk_apex = np.array([bx, by, trunk_height])
381
382                # Find document nodes (trunk base)
383                doc_nodes = [n for n in book_nodes if n.kind == "document"]
384                for doc in doc_nodes:
385                    positions[doc.id] = np.array([bx, by, 0.0])
386                    self.trunk_positions[doc.id] = np.array([bx, by, 0.0])
387                    self.trunk_heights[doc.id] = trunk_height
388                    self.trunk_genres[doc.id] = genre
389
390                # Section nodes — spiral up the trunk (B: real tree branching)
391                section_nodes = [n for n in book_nodes if n.kind == "section"]
392                n_sections = len(section_nodes)
393                golden_angle = np.pi * (3.0 - np.sqrt(5.0))  # ≈ 137.5°
394                branch_length = 0.0  # reused by canopy cloud below
395                if n_sections:
396                    branch_length = self.branch_radius + np.sqrt(n_sections) * 0.5
397                    for i, sec in enumerate(section_nodes):
398                        t = i / max(n_sections - 1, 1)
399                        z = trunk_height * (0.30 + 0.65 * t)
400                        angle = i * golden_angle
401                        radius = branch_length * (1.0 - (z / trunk_height) * 0.4)
402                        sec_pos = np.array(
403                            [
404                                bx + radius * np.cos(angle),
405                                by + radius * np.sin(angle),
406                                z,
407                            ]
408                        )
409                        positions[sec.id] = sec_pos
410                        # Branch line: point on trunk axis at section's Z → section tip
411                        self.branch_lines.append((np.array([bx, by, z]), sec_pos))
412
413                # Chunk nodes — upper-hemisphere cone above each branch tip
414                sec_chunks: dict[str, list[str]] = {
415                    n.id: children.get(n.id, []) for n in section_nodes
416                }
417                for sec in section_nodes:
418                    _pos = positions.get(sec.id)
419                    if _pos is None:
420                        continue
421                    sec_pos = _pos
422                    chunk_ids = [
423                        cid
424                        for cid in sec_chunks.get(sec.id, [])
425                        if node_by_id.get(cid) and node_by_id[cid].kind == "chunk"
426                    ]
427                    n_c = len(chunk_ids)
428                    if not n_c:
429                        continue
430                    leaf_r = self.leaf_radius + np.sqrt(n_c) * 0.12
431                    raw_pts = fibonacci_sphere(n_c * 3, radius=leaf_r, center=sec_pos)
432                    upper_pts = [p for p in raw_pts if p[2] >= float(sec_pos[2])]
433                    if len(upper_pts) < n_c:
434                        # Reflect insufficient points above branch Z
435                        upper_pts = [
436                            np.array(
437                                [p[0], p[1], float(sec_pos[2]) + abs(p[2] - float(sec_pos[2]))]
438                            )
439                            for p in raw_pts[:n_c]
440                        ]
441                    for cid, cpos in zip(chunk_ids, upper_pts[:n_c]):
442                        positions[cid] = np.array(cpos)
443
444                # Chunks without a section parent (connected directly to document)
445                doc_chunk_ids: list[str] = []
446                for doc in doc_nodes:
447                    doc_chunk_ids.extend(
448                        cid
449                        for cid in children.get(doc.id, [])
450                        if node_by_id.get(cid)
451                        and node_by_id[cid].kind == "chunk"
452                        and cid not in positions
453                    )
454                if doc_chunk_ids:
455                    raw_pts = fibonacci_sphere(
456                        len(doc_chunk_ids) * 2, radius=self.leaf_radius, center=trunk_apex
457                    )
458                    upper_pts = [p for p in raw_pts if p[2] >= float(trunk_apex[2])]
459                    if len(upper_pts) < len(doc_chunk_ids):
460                        upper_pts = raw_pts[: len(doc_chunk_ids)]
461                    for cid, cpos in zip(doc_chunk_ids, upper_pts[: len(doc_chunk_ids)]):
462                        positions[cid] = np.array(cpos)
463
464                # Entity / topic / keyword → loose cloud above canopy
465                canopy_z = trunk_height + self.canopy_lift
466                canopy_center = np.array([bx, by, canopy_z])
467                floaters = [
468                    n
469                    for n in book_nodes
470                    if n.kind in ("entity", "topic", "keyword") and n.id not in positions
471                ]
472                if floaters:
473                    cloud_r = branch_length * 1.1 if n_sections else self.branch_radius
474                    cloud_pts = fibonacci_sphere(
475                        len(floaters), radius=cloud_r, center=canopy_center
476                    )
477                    for n, pos in zip(floaters, cloud_pts):
478                        positions[n.id] = np.array(pos)
479
480        # Orphans (anything still unplaced)
481        orphans = [n for n in nodes if n.id not in positions]
482        if orphans:
483            orphan_pts = fibonacci_sphere(len(orphans), radius=5.0, center=np.zeros(3))
484            for n, pos in zip(orphans, orphan_pts):
485                positions[n.id] = np.array(pos)
486
487        return positions

3-D forest layout for a multi-book corpus.

Spatial structure

  • Genres are placed in a large Fibonacci annulus in the XY plane (each genre → a grove at a fixed XY centre).
  • Books within a genre are placed in a medium Fibonacci annulus around the genre centre.
  • Per book (tree):
    • document node sits at the book's XY position, Z = 0 (trunk base marker).
    • section nodes are distributed on a Fibonacci upper hemisphere centred at the trunk apex (bx, by, trunk_height). Trunk height scales as log2(1 + n_chunks).
    • chunk nodes cluster around their parent section node in a small Fibonacci sphere.
    • entity/topic nodes float in a loose cloud above the canopy at Z = trunk_height + canopy_lift.
Parameters
  • grove_inner_radius: Inner radius for genre placement ring.
  • grove_outer_radius: Minimum outer radius for genre ring.
  • book_inner_radius: Inner radius for books within a genre grove.
  • book_outer_radius: Minimum outer radius within a genre grove.
  • trunk_scale: Multiplier for trunk height (trunk_height = trunk_scale * log2(1 + n_chunks)).
  • branch_radius: Base radius of the Fibonacci hemisphere for sections.
  • leaf_radius: Base radius of the leaf sphere per section.
  • canopy_lift: Z offset above trunk apex for entity / topic nodes.

class TextPopup(PyQt5.QtWidgets.QDialog): 
574class TextPopup(QDialog):
575    """
576    Modeless popup that renders node text as Markdown HTML.
577
578    :param title: Window title.
579    :param text: Raw text content.
580    :param parent: Parent widget.
581    :param on_close_callback: Called when the window closes.
582    """
583
584    def __init__(self, title: str, text: str, parent=None, on_close_callback=None):
585        """Build the popup dialog: title bar, rendered Markdown browser, and Close button."""
586        super().__init__(parent)
587        self.setWindowTitle(title)
588        self.setMinimumSize(640, 420)
589        self.on_close_callback = on_close_callback
590        self.setWindowModality(Qt.NonModal)  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
591
592        if parent:
593            geo = parent.screen().geometry()
594            self.move(geo.x() + 60, geo.y() + 60)
595
596        layout = QVBoxLayout(self)
597        html = markdown(text or "No text available.")
598        browser = QTextBrowser(self)
599        browser.setHtml(html)
600        layout.addWidget(browser)
601
602        close_btn = QPushButton("Close", self)
603        close_btn.clicked.connect(self.close)  # type: ignore[arg-type]
604        layout.addWidget(close_btn)
605
606    def closeEvent(self, event):
607        """Invoke the close callback, if any, then let the dialog close normally."""
608        if self.on_close_callback:
609            self.on_close_callback()
610        super().closeEvent(event)

584    def __init__(self, title: str, text: str, parent=None, on_close_callback=None):
