def create_forest_visualization( viz: GutenbergForestVisualizer, nodes: list[pycode_kg.layout3d.LayoutNode], edges: list[pycode_kg.layout3d.LayoutEdge], plotter: pyvista.plotting.plotter.Plotter) -> tuple[pyvista.plotting.plotter.Plotter, str, dict[str, dict]]: 
618def create_forest_visualization(
619    viz: GutenbergForestVisualizer,
620    nodes: list[LayoutNode],
621    edges: list[LayoutEdge],
622    plotter: pv.Plotter,
623) -> tuple[pv.Plotter, str, dict[str, dict]]:
624    """
625    Render the knowledge tree forest into *plotter*.
626
627    Draws:
628    - Forest floor (ground plane)
629    - Per-book trunk cylinders (visual, not node meshes)
630    - Node meshes grouped by kind (LOD-aware)
631    - Structural edges (CONTAINS gray lines; SIMILAR_TO arcs)
632
633    :param viz: :class:`GutenbergForestVisualizer` instance.
634    :param nodes: Filtered node list to render.
635    :param edges: Full edge list (used for layout and edge rendering).
636    :param plotter: The ``QtInteractor`` to render into.
637    :return: ``(plotter, title_text, actor_to_node)``
638    """
639    viz.status = "Building forest scene..."
640    QApplication.processEvents()
641
642    plotter.clear_actors()
643    plotter.enable_anti_aliasing("msaa")
644    plotter.set_background("#1a1a2e", top="#16213e")  # type: ignore[arg-type]  # night forest sky
645
646    # Ground plane — sized for 2× grove spacing
647    ground = pv.Plane(center=(0, 0, -0.2), direction=(0, 0, 1), i_size=1000, j_size=1000)
648    plotter.add_mesh(ground, color="#2d4a1e", opacity=1.0, name="ground")
649
650    # -- Compute layout
651    layout = ForestLayout()
652    layout._book_genre_map = viz._book_genre_map  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
653    all_positions = layout.compute(viz.all_nodes, viz.all_edges)
654
655    # -- Draw trunk cylinders — single merged mesh with genre_idx scalar (A)
656    # One add_mesh call regardless of genre count keeps actor/texture count low.
657    viz.status = "Drawing trunks..."
658    QApplication.processEvents()
659    _trunk_meshes: list[pv.PolyData] = []
660    _genre_list_ord = sorted(layout.genre_color_map.keys())
661    _genre_to_idx: dict[str, float] = {g: float(i) for i, g in enumerate(_genre_list_ord)}
662    for doc_id, base in layout.trunk_positions.items():
663        height = layout.trunk_heights.get(doc_id, 8.0)
664        genre = layout.trunk_genres.get(doc_id, "unknown")
665        cyl = pv.Cylinder(
666            center=(base[0], base[1], height / 2),
667            direction=(0, 0, 1),
668            radius=0.4,
669            height=height,
670            resolution=12,
671        )
672        cyl.cell_data["genre_idx"] = np.full(cyl.n_cells, _genre_to_idx.get(genre, 0.0))
673        _trunk_meshes.append(cyl)
674    if _trunk_meshes:
675        from matplotlib.colors import ListedColormap  # pyvista dependency, always present
676
677        _combined_trunks = pv.merge(_trunk_meshes)
678        _genre_colors = [layout.genre_color_map.get(g, TRUNK_COLOR) for g in _genre_list_ord]
679        _trunk_cmap = ListedColormap(_genre_colors)
680        _n_genres = max(1, len(_genre_list_ord))
681        plotter.add_mesh(
682            _combined_trunks,
683            scalars="genre_idx",
684            cmap=_trunk_cmap,
685            clim=[-0.5, _n_genres - 0.5],
686            show_scalar_bar=False,
687            name="trunks",
688        )
689
690    # -- Branch lines: trunk-axis point → section tip (flat numpy, zero per-line objects)
691    if layout.branch_lines:
692        _n_bl = len(layout.branch_lines)
693        _bl_pts = np.empty((_n_bl * 2, 3), dtype=float)
694        _bl_pts[0::2] = [bl[0] for bl in layout.branch_lines]
695        _bl_pts[1::2] = [bl[1] for bl in layout.branch_lines]
696        _bl_cells = np.empty(_n_bl * 3, dtype=np.intp)
697        _bl_cells[0::3] = 2
698        _bl_cells[1::3] = np.arange(0, _n_bl * 2, 2)
699        _bl_cells[2::3] = np.arange(1, _n_bl * 2 + 1, 2)
700        _branch_mesh = pv.PolyData()
701        _branch_mesh.points = _bl_pts
702        _branch_mesh.lines = _bl_cells
703        plotter.add_mesh(
704            _branch_mesh, color=BRANCH_COLOR, line_width=2.0, opacity=0.85, name="branches"
705        )
706
707    # -- LOD tier
708    n_visible = len(nodes)
709    lod = "high" if n_visible <= LOD_HIGH else "low" if n_visible <= LOD_LOW else "points"
710
711    # -- Glyph rendering: O(kinds) Python work, not O(nodes)
712    # Bucket positions and metadata by kind in one pass, then glyph each kind.
713    kind_pts: dict[str, list[np.ndarray]] = {k: [] for k in KIND_SIZE}
714    kind_meta: dict[str, list] = {k: [] for k in KIND_SIZE}
715    node_id_set: set[str] = set()
716
717    for node in nodes:
718        pos = all_positions.get(node.id)
719        if pos is None:
720            continue
721        kind = node.kind if node.kind in KIND_SIZE else "chunk"
722        kind_pts[kind].append(pos)
723        kind_meta[kind].append(node)
724        node_id_set.add(node.id)
725
726    actor_to_node: dict[str, dict] = {}
727    viz.status = "Rendering nodes..."
728    QApplication.processEvents()
729
730    for kind in KIND_SIZE:
731        pts = kind_pts[kind]
732        if not pts:
733            continue
734        arr = np.array(pts, dtype=float)
735        cloud = pv.PolyData(arr)
736        proto = _glyph_proto(kind, KIND_SIZE[kind], lod)
737        glyphed = cloud.glyph(geom=proto, orient=False, scale=False)
738        plotter.add_mesh(glyphed, color=KIND_COLOR[kind], show_edges=False, name=f"{kind}_nodes")
739        for i, (node, pos) in enumerate(zip(kind_meta[kind], pts)):
740            actor_to_node[f"{kind}_{i}"] = {
741                "kind": kind,
742                "id": node.id,
743                "name": node.name,
744                "docstring": node.docstring,
745                "position": np.asarray(pos, float),
746            }
747
748    # -- Edge rendering (CONTAINS structural lines + optional SIMILAR_TO arcs)
749    viz.status = "Rendering edges..."
750    QApplication.processEvents()
751
752    rel_to_show: set[str] = set()
753    if viz.show_contains:
754        rel_to_show.add("CONTAINS")
755    if viz.show_similar:
756        rel_to_show.add("SIMILAR_TO")
757    if viz.show_next:
758        rel_to_show.add("NEXT")
759
760    rel_blocks: dict[str, pv.MultiBlock] = {r: pv.MultiBlock() for r in rel_to_show}
761    edge_counts: dict[str, int] = {r: 0 for r in rel_to_show}
762    MAX_EDGES = 4000
763
764    for edge in edges:
765        if edge.rel not in rel_to_show:
766            continue
767        if edge.src not in node_id_set or edge.dst not in node_id_set:
768            continue
769        if edge_counts[edge.rel] >= MAX_EDGES:
770            continue
771        p1, p2 = all_positions.get(edge.src), all_positions.get(edge.dst)
772        if p1 is None or p2 is None:
773            continue
774        if edge.rel == "CONTAINS":
775            rel_blocks["CONTAINS"].append(pv.Line(p1, p2))
776        else:
777            arc_pts = _arc_points(p1, p2)
778            rel_blocks[edge.rel].append(pv.Spline(arc_pts, n_points=24))
779        edge_counts[edge.rel] += 1
780
781    for rel, block in rel_blocks.items():
782        if block.n_blocks > 0:
783            is_contains = rel == "CONTAINS"
784            plotter.add_mesh(
785                block,
786                color=REL_COLOR[rel],
787                line_width=3.0 if is_contains else 2.0,
788                opacity=0.45 if is_contains else 0.8,
789                name=f"{rel.lower()}_edges",
790            )
791
792    # -- Stats
793    counts = Counter(n.kind for n in nodes)
794    title = (
795        f"Gutenberg KG Forest | {len({n.id.split(':')[0] for n in viz.all_nodes})} books | "
796        f"docs={counts.get('document', 0)}  "
797        f"sections={counts.get('section', 0)}  "
798        f"chunks={counts.get('chunk', 0)}  "
799        f"entities={counts.get('entity', 0)}"
800    )
801
802    plotter.reset_camera()  # type: ignore[call-arg]
803    plotter.view_isometric()  # type: ignore[call-arg]
804    plotter.render()
805    plotter.camera.zoom(2)
806
807    viz.status = "Forest rendered."
808    QApplication.processEvents()
809    return plotter, title, actor_to_node

Render the knowledge tree forest into plotter.

Draws:

  • Forest floor (ground plane)
  • Per-book trunk cylinders (visual, not node meshes)
  • Node meshes grouped by kind (LOD-aware)
  • Structural edges (CONTAINS gray lines; SIMILAR_TO arcs)
Parameters
  • viz: GutenbergForestVisualizer instance.
  • nodes: Filtered node list to render.
  • edges: Full edge list (used for layout and edge rendering).
  • plotter: The QtInteractor to render into.
Returns

(plotter, title_text, actor_to_node)

class GutenbergForestVisualizer(param.parameterized.Parameterized): 
817class GutenbergForestVisualizer(param.Parameterized):
818    """
819    Data and state model for the Gutenberg 3-D forest visualiser.
820
821    Reactive attributes (via ``param``) drive the Qt control panel.
822
823    :param corpus_root: Path to the corpus directory.
824    :param plotter: The ``QtInteractor`` to render into.
825    """
826
827    corpus_root: str = param.String(default=DEFAULT_CORPUS, doc="Corpus root path")
828    save_path: str = param.String(default=DEFAULT_SAVE, doc="Save path stem")
829    save_format: str = param.Selector(
830        objects=["html", "png", "jpg"], default="html", doc="Export format"
831    )
832
833    # Visibility toggles by node kind
834    show_sections: bool = param.Boolean(default=True, doc="Render section (branch) nodes")
835    show_chunks: bool = param.Boolean(default=True, doc="Render chunk (leaf) nodes")
836    show_entities: bool = param.Boolean(default=False, doc="Render entity / topic nodes")
837
838    # Edge visibility
839    show_contains: bool = param.Boolean(default=False, doc="CONTAINS structural edges")
840    show_similar: bool = param.Boolean(default=False, doc="SIMILAR_TO semantic edges")
841    show_next: bool = param.Boolean(default=False, doc="NEXT sequential edges")
842
843    # Status / title
844    status: str = param.String(default="Ready", doc="Status bar text")
845    window_title: str = param.String(
846        default=f"Gutenberg KG Forest v{__version__}", doc="Window title"
847    )
848
849    # Stats
850    num_books: int = param.Integer(default=0)
851    num_genres: int = param.Integer(default=0)
852
853    # Genre / book selectors
854    available_genres: list[str] = param.List(default=[], doc="Available genre names")
855    selected_genres: list[str] = param.ListSelector(default=[], objects=[], doc="Selected genres")
856    available_books: list[str] = param.List(default=[], doc="Books in selected genres")
857    selected_books: list[str] = param.ListSelector(
858        default=[], objects=[], doc="Selected books (empty = all in genre)"
859    )
860
861    def __init__(self, plotter: pv.Plotter | None = None, **params) -> None:
862        """
863        Initialise the visualiser data model.
864
865        :param plotter: The ``QtInteractor`` to render into.
866        :param params: Additional ``param`` keyword arguments.
867        """
868        super().__init__(**params)
869        self.plotter: pv.Plotter | None = plotter
870
871        # Book catalogue: {genre: [BookMeta]}
872        self._catalogue: dict[str, list[BookMeta]] = {}
873        # Loaded graph data (all books currently selected)
874        self.all_nodes: list[LayoutNode] = []
875        self.all_edges: list[LayoutEdge] = []
876        # slug → genre mapping for ForestLayout
877        self._book_genre_map: dict[str, str] = {}
878
879        self.actor_to_node: dict[str, dict] = {}
880        self._load_catalogue()
881
882    @param.depends("corpus_root", watch=True)
883    def _load_catalogue(self) -> None:
884        """Scan corpus_root and populate the genre/book selectors."""
885        root = Path(self.corpus_root)
886        if not root.exists():
887            self.status = f"Corpus not found: {root}"
888            return
889
890        self.status = "Scanning corpus..."
891        QApplication.processEvents()
892
893        self._catalogue = scan_corpus(root)
894        genres = sorted(self._catalogue.keys())
895        self.available_genres = genres
896        self.param.selected_genres.objects = genres
897        self.selected_genres = []
898
899        n_books = sum(len(v) for v in self._catalogue.values())
900        self.num_genres = len(genres)
901        self.num_books = n_books
902        self.status = f"Corpus: {len(genres)} genres, {n_books} ingested books"
903
904    @param.depends("selected_genres", watch=True)
905    def _on_genre_change(self) -> None:
906        """Refresh available books when genre selection changes."""
907        books: list[str] = []
908        for genre in self.selected_genres:
909            for meta in self._catalogue.get(genre, []):
910                books.append(meta.title)
911        books.sort()
912        self.available_books = books
913        self.param.selected_books.objects = books
914        self.selected_books = []
915
916    def load_selected(self) -> None:
917        """
918        Load nodes and edges for the currently selected genres/books.
919        Populates :attr:`all_nodes`, :attr:`all_edges`, :attr:`_book_genre_map`.
920        """
921        self.status = "Loading book graphs..."
922        QApplication.processEvents()
923
924        genres_to_load = self.selected_genres or list(self._catalogue.keys())
925        books_filter = set(self.selected_books)
926
927        self.all_nodes = []
928        self.all_edges = []
929        self._book_genre_map = {}
930
931        loaded = 0
932        for genre in genres_to_load:
933            for meta in self._catalogue.get(genre, []):
934                if books_filter and meta.title not in books_filter:
935                    continue
936                self.status = f"Loading: {meta.title}"
937                QApplication.processEvents()
938                try:
939                    nodes, edges = _load_book_graph(meta)
940                    self.all_nodes.extend(nodes)
941                    self.all_edges.extend(edges)
942                    self._book_genre_map[meta.slug] = genre
943                    loaded += 1
944                except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
945                    logger.warning("Failed to load %s: %s", meta.title, exc)
946
947        self.status = (
948            f"Loaded {loaded} book(s): {len(self.all_nodes):,} nodes, {len(self.all_edges):,} edges"
949        )
950
951    def _visible_nodes(self) -> list[LayoutNode]:
952        """Apply kind visibility filters and return renderable node list."""
953        visible_kinds: set[str] = {"document"}
954        if self.show_sections:
955            visible_kinds.add("section")
956        if self.show_chunks:
957            visible_kinds.add("chunk")
958        if self.show_entities:
959            visible_kinds.update(("entity", "topic", "keyword"))
960        return [n for n in self.all_nodes if n.kind in visible_kinds]
961
962    def visualize(self) -> None:
963        """Load selected books and render the 3-D forest."""
964        if not self.plotter:
965            return
966        self.load_selected()
967        if not self.all_nodes:
968            self.status = "No books loaded — select a genre and render."
969            return
970
971        visible = self._visible_nodes()
972        try:
973            _, title, actor_to_node = create_forest_visualization(
974                self, visible, self.all_edges, self.plotter
975            )
976            self.actor_to_node = actor_to_node
977            self.window_title = title
978        except (ValueError, RuntimeError) as exc:
979            self.status = f"Error: {exc}"
980            logger.exception("Render error")

class ForestMainWindow(PyQt5.QtWidgets.QMainWindow): 
 988class ForestMainWindow(QMainWindow):
 989    """
 990    Qt main window for the Gutenberg 3-D forest visualiser.
 991
 992    Left panel  — corpus path, genre selector, book selector, render options.
 993    Right panel — PyVista QtInteractor + button row.
 994
 995    :param corpus_root: Path to the corpus directory.
 996    :param save_path: Default output file stem for exports.
 997    :param width: Initial window width in pixels.
 998    :param height: Initial window height in pixels.
 999    """
1000
1001    status_changed: pyqtSignal = pyqtSignal(str)
1002
1003    def __init__(
1004        self,
1005        corpus_root: str = DEFAULT_CORPUS,
1006        save_path: str = DEFAULT_SAVE,
1007        width: int = 1500,
1008        height: int = 950,
1009    ) -> None:
1010        """Build the main window: control/viewport panels, mesh picking, and signal wiring."""
1011        super().__init__()
1012        self.timer = None
1013        self._current_picked_actor = None
1014        self._current_popup: TextPopup | None = None
1015
1016        self.setGeometry(100, 100, width, height)
1017
1018        self.vtk_plotter: QtInteractor = QtInteractor(self)
1019        self.visualizer: GutenbergForestVisualizer = GutenbergForestVisualizer(

1283    # -- Render / pick -------------------------------------------------------
1284
1285    def on_render_clicked(self) -> None:
1286        """Render Forest button handler: trigger a full load + render of the scene."""
1287        self.visualizer.visualize()
1288
1289    def on_pick(self, actor) -> None:
1290        """Right-click callback: find nearest node and show text popup."""
1291        if not self.visualizer.plotter:
1292            return
1293        self._clear_highlight()
1294        if self._current_popup and self._current_popup.isVisible():
1295            self._current_popup.close()
1296            self._current_popup = None
1297        if actor is None:
1298            self.update_status_display("Right-click a node sphere or trunk to inspect.")
1299            return
1300        if not hasattr(self.vtk_plotter, "picked_point") or self.vtk_plotter.picked_point is None:
1301            self.update_status_display("No pick point — zoom in and right-click closer to a node.")
1302            return
1303
1304        picked_point = np.asarray(self.vtk_plotter.picked_point, float)
1305
1306        # Identify actor name and map to a node kind
1307        picked_kind: str | None = None
1308        for name, act in self.plotter.actors.items():
1309            if act != actor:
1310                continue
1311            if name == "trunks":
1312                # Trunk click → find nearest document node (shows book info)
1313                picked_kind = "document"
1314            else:
1315                for kind in KIND_SIZE:
1316                    if name == f"{kind}_nodes":
1317                        picked_kind = kind
1318                        break
1319            break
1320
1321        if picked_kind is None:
1322            self.update_status_display("Click on a node sphere or trunk cylinder.")
1323            return
1324
1325        # Find closest node of that kind
1326        best_id, best_dist = None, float("inf")
1327        for mesh_id, elem in self.visualizer.actor_to_node.items():
1328            if elem["kind"] != picked_kind:
1329                continue
1330            d = float(np.linalg.norm(np.asarray(elem["position"], float) - picked_point))
1331            if d < best_dist:
1332                best_dist = d
1333                best_id = mesh_id
1334
1335        if best_id is None:
1336            self.update_status_display(f"No {picked_kind} node near pick point.")
1337            return
1338
1339        elem = self.visualizer.actor_to_node[best_id]
1340        # Build highlight mesh at the picked node position (no per-node mesh stored)
1341        pos = np.asarray(elem["position"], float)
1342        highlight = _make_node_mesh(elem["kind"], pos, KIND_SIZE[elem["kind"]] * 1.5, "high")
1343        self._highlight_mesh(highlight)
1344
1345        kind_label = elem["kind"].capitalize()
1346        raw_name = elem["name"]
1347        title = f"{kind_label}: {raw_name}"
1348        text = elem.get("docstring") or f"**{raw_name}**\n\n_{kind_label} node._"
1349        self._current_popup = TextPopup(title, text, self, on_close_callback=self._on_popup_close)
1350        self._current_popup.show()
1351        self.update_status_display(f"Picked: {title} (dist {best_dist:.1f})")
1352
1353    def _highlight_mesh(self, mesh) -> None:
1354        """Clear any existing highlight, then add *mesh* as the yellow-edged highlight actor."""
1355        self._clear_highlight()
1356        self.plotter.add_mesh(
1357            mesh,
1358            color="white",
1359            show_edges=True,
1360            edge_color="yellow",
1361            line_width=3,
1362            pickable=False,
1363            show_scalar_bar=False,
1364            reset_camera=False,
1365            name="_forest_highlight",
1366        )
1367        self._current_picked_actor = self.plotter.actors.get("_forest_highlight")
1368
1369    def _clear_highlight(self) -> None:
1370        """Remove the current pick-highlight actor from the plotter, if one exists."""
1371        if self._current_picked_actor:
1372            try:
1373                self.plotter.remove_actor(self._current_picked_actor, reset_camera=False)
1374            except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
1375                pass
1376            self._current_picked_actor = None
1377
1378    def _on_popup_close(self) -> None:
1379        """TextPopup close callback: clear the pick highlight and re-render the scene."""
1380        self._clear_highlight()
1381        self.plotter.render()
1382
1383    def show_selected_text(self) -> None:
1384        """Show text for the first selected book in the book selector."""
1385        items = self.book_selector.selectedItems()
1386        if not items:
1387            self.update_status_display("Select a book first.")
1388            return
1389        book_title = items[0].text()
1390        self._current_popup = TextPopup(
1391            book_title,
1392            f"**{book_title}**\n\nSelect a node in the scene to view its text.",
1393            self,
1394            on_close_callback=self._on_popup_close,
1395        )
1396        self._current_popup.show()

1399
1400    def reset_camera(self) -> None:
1401        """Reset the plotter camera to the default isometric view and zoom level."""
1402        if not self.plotter:
1403            return
1404        self.plotter.reset_camera()  # type: ignore[call-arg]
1405        self.plotter.view_isometric()  # type: ignore[call-arg]
1406        self.plotter.render()
1407        self.plotter.camera.zoom(2)
1408
1409    # -- Save ----------------------------------------------------------------
1410
1411    def save_current_view(self) -> None:
1412        """Save View button handler: export the current scene to HTML or a screenshot."""
1413        save_path = Path(self.visualizer.save_path)
1414        fmt = self.visualizer.save_format
1415        if save_path.suffix.lstrip(".") != fmt:
1416            save_path = save_path.with_suffix(f".{fmt}")
1417        self.visualizer.status = f"Saving → {save_path}…"
1418        QApplication.processEvents()
1419        try:
1420            save_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
1421            if fmt == "html":
1422                self.plotter.export_html(str(save_path))
1423            else:
1424                self.plotter.screenshot(str(save_path))
1425            self.visualizer.status = f"Saved → {save_path}"
1426        except (OSError, RuntimeError, ImportError) as exc:
1427            self.visualizer.status = f"Error saving: {exc}"
1428
1429    # -- Reset ---------------------------------------------------------------
1430
1431    def reset_settings(self) -> None:
1432        """Reset Settings button handler: clear selections, restore default visibility
1433        checkboxes, and reset the camera."""
1434        self.genre_selector.clearSelection()
1435        self.book_selector.clearSelection()
1436        self.cb_sections.setChecked(True)
1437        self.cb_chunks.setChecked(True)
1438        self.cb_entities.setChecked(False)
1439        self.cb_contains.setChecked(True)
1440        self.cb_similar.setChecked(False)
1441        self.cb_next.setChecked(False)
1442        self.reset_camera()
1443        self.visualizer.status = "Ready"
1444
1445    # -- Status --------------------------------------------------------------
1446
1447    def on_status_change(self, event: param.Event) -> None:
1448        """``param`` watcher for ``visualizer.status``: re-emit as the Qt ``status_changed`` signal."""
1449        self.status_changed.emit(event.new)
1450        QApplication.processEvents()
1451
1452    def update_status_display(self, status: str) -> None:
1453        """Render *status* into the status label, color-coded by message type (error/busy/done)."""
1454        if status.startswith("Error"):
1455            html = f"<span style='color:#FF6B6B;font-size:13px;'><b>{status}</b></span>"
1456        elif any(kw in status for kw in ("Rendering", "Loading", "Building", "Drawing")):
1457            html = f"<span style='color:#87CEEB;font-size:13px;'><b>⏳ {status}</b></span>"
1458        elif any(kw in status for kw in ("rendered", "Saved", "Loaded", "Corpus")):
1459            html = f"<span style='color:#90EE90;font-size:13px;'><b>✓ {status}</b></span>"
1460        else:
1461            html = f"<span style='color:#c0c0c0;font-size:13px;'>{status}</span>"
1462        self.status_display.setText(html)
1463
1464    def update_window_title(self, event: param.Event) -> None:
1465        """``param`` watcher for ``visualizer.window_title``: apply it to the Qt window."""
1466        self.setWindowTitle(event.new)
1467
1468    # -- Cleanup -------------------------------------------------------------
1469
1470    def cleanup(self) -> None:
1471        """Close any open popup and tear down the VTK plotter to release GPU resources."""
1472        if self._current_popup and hasattr(self._current_popup, "isVisible"):
1473            try:
1474                self._current_popup.close()
1475            except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
1476                pass
1477        if self.plotter:
1478            try:
1479                self.plotter.clear_actors()
1480                self.plotter.close()
1481                self.visualizer.plotter = None
1482                self.plotter = None
1483                self.vtk_plotter = None
1484            except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
1485                pass
1486        gc.collect()
1487
1488    def closeEvent(self, event) -> None:
1489        """Qt window-close handler: run :meth:`cleanup` (warnings suppressed) then accept."""
1490        with warnings.catch_warnings():
1491            warnings.simplefilter("ignore")
1492            try:
1493                self.cleanup()
1494            except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
1495                pass
1496        event.accept()

Qt main window for the Gutenberg 3-D forest visualiser.

Left panel — corpus path, genre selector, book selector, render options. Right panel — PyVista QtInteractor + button row.

Parameters
  • corpus_root: Path to the corpus directory.
  • save_path: Default output file stem for exports.
  • width: Initial window width in pixels.
  • height: Initial window height in pixels.

def status_changed(unknown):

pyqtSignal(*types, name: str = ..., revision: int = ..., arguments: Sequence = ...) -> PYQT_SIGNAL

types is normally a sequence of individual types. Each type is either a type object or a string that is the name of a C++ type. Alternatively each type could itself be a sequence of types each describing a different overloaded signal. name is the optional C++ name of the signal. If it is not specified then the name of the class attribute that is bound to the signal is used. revision is the optional revision of the signal that is exported to QML. If it is not specified then 0 is used. arguments is the optional sequence of the names of the signal's arguments.

def on_pick(self, actor) -> None: 
1289    def on_pick(self, actor) -> None:
1290        """Right-click callback: find nearest node and show text popup."""
1291        if not self.visualizer.plotter:
1292            return
1293        self._clear_highlight()
1294        if self._current_popup and self._current_popup.isVisible():
1295            self._current_popup.close()
1296            self._current_popup = None
1297        if actor is None:
1298            self.update_status_display("Right-click a node sphere or trunk to inspect.")
1299            return
1300        if not hasattr(self.vtk_plotter, "picked_point") or self.vtk_plotter.picked_point is None:
1301            self.update_status_display("No pick point — zoom in and right-click closer to a node.")
1302            return
1303
1304        picked_point = np.asarray(self.vtk_plotter.picked_point, float)
1305
1306        # Identify actor name and map to a node kind
1307        picked_kind: str | None = None
1308        for name, act in self.plotter.actors.items():
1309            if act != actor:
1310                continue
1311            if name == "trunks":
1312                # Trunk click → find nearest document node (shows book info)
1313                picked_kind = "document"
1314            else:
1315                for kind in KIND_SIZE:
1316                    if name == f"{kind}_nodes":
1317                        picked_kind = kind
1318                        break
1319            break
1320
1321        if picked_kind is None:
1322            self.update_status_display("Click on a node sphere or trunk cylinder.")
1323            return
1324
1325        # Find closest node of that kind
1326        best_id, best_dist = None, float("inf")
1327        for mesh_id, elem in self.visualizer.actor_to_node.items():
1328            if elem["kind"] != picked_kind:
1329                continue
1330            d = float(np.linalg.norm(np.asarray(elem["position"], float) - picked_point))
1331            if d < best_dist:
1332                best_dist = d
1333                best_id = mesh_id
1334
1335        if best_id is None:
1336            self.update_status_display(f"No {picked_kind} node near pick point.")
1337            return
1338
1339        elem = self.visualizer.actor_to_node[best_id]
1340        # Build highlight mesh at the picked node position (no per-node mesh stored)
1341        pos = np.asarray(elem["position"], float)
1342        highlight = _make_node_mesh(elem["kind"], pos, KIND_SIZE[elem["kind"]] * 1.5, "high")
1343        self._highlight_mesh(highlight)
1344
1345        kind_label = elem["kind"].capitalize()
1346        raw_name = elem["name"]
1347        title = f"{kind_label}: {raw_name}"
1348        text = elem.get("docstring") or f"**{raw_name}**\n\n_{kind_label} node._"
1349        self._current_popup = TextPopup(title, text, self, on_close_callback=self._on_popup_close)
1350        self._current_popup.show()
1351        self.update_status_display(f"Picked: {title} (dist {best_dist:.1f})")

Right-click callback: find nearest node and show text popup.

1411    def save_current_view(self) -> None:
1412        """Save View button handler: export the current scene to HTML or a screenshot."""
1413        save_path = Path(self.visualizer.save_path)
1414        fmt = self.visualizer.save_format
1415        if save_path.suffix.lstrip(".") != fmt:
1416            save_path = save_path.with_suffix(f".{fmt}")
1417        self.visualizer.status = f"Saving → {save_path}…"
1418        QApplication.processEvents()
1419        try:
1420            save_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
1421            if fmt == "html":
1422                self.plotter.export_html(str(save_path))
1423            else:
1424                self.plotter.screenshot(str(save_path))
1425            self.visualizer.status = f"Saved → {save_path}"
1426        except (OSError, RuntimeError, ImportError) as exc:
1427            self.visualizer.status = f"Error saving: {exc}"

def update_status_display(self, status: str) -> None: 
1452    def update_status_display(self, status: str) -> None:
1453        """Render *status* into the status label, color-coded by message type (error/busy/done)."""
1454        if status.startswith("Error"):
1455            html = f"<span style='color:#FF6B6B;font-size:13px;'><b>{status}</b></span>"
1456        elif any(kw in status for kw in ("Rendering", "Loading", "Building", "Drawing")):
1457            html = f"<span style='color:#87CEEB;font-size:13px;'><b>⏳ {status}</b></span>"
1458        elif any(kw in status for kw in ("rendered", "Saved", "Loaded", "Corpus")):
1459            html = f"<span style='color:#90EE90;font-size:13px;'><b>✓ {status}</b></span>"
1460        else:
1461            html = f"<span style='color:#c0c0c0;font-size:13px;'>{status}</span>"
1462        self.status_display.setText(html)

def cleanup(self) -> None: 
1470    def cleanup(self) -> None:
1471        """Close any open popup and tear down the VTK plotter to release GPU resources."""
1472        if self._current_popup and hasattr(self._current_popup, "isVisible"):
1473            try:
1474                self._current_popup.close()
1475            except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
1476                pass
1477        if self.plotter:
1478            try:
1479                self.plotter.clear_actors()
1480                self.plotter.close()
1481                self.visualizer.plotter = None
1482                self.plotter = None
1483                self.vtk_plotter = None
1484            except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
1485                pass
1486        gc.collect()
